title: CRLR/142/2013 of Smt. Poonam Dhawan AND ANOTHER Vs Manoj Dhawan

paras.text:
CRLR No. 142 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J
 Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for the revisionists.
 None for the respondent.
 Present revision is preferred assailing the
judgment and order dated 28.05.2013, passed by
Principal Judge, Family Court, Dehradun, whereby
both the applicants/revisionists were awarded
maintenance at the rate of `5,000/- per month each,
in total, `10,000/- per month.
 Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned counsel, appearing for
the revisionists, submits that maintenance, so
awarded by the learned Principal Judge, Family
Court, Dehradun is on the lower side and it should be
increased upto `25,000/- per month.
 Perusal of the impugned judgment and order
would reveal that annual income of the
husband/respondent, as per the income tax return was
`1,60,000/- per annum, which comes to be
approximately 14-15,000/- per month and out of
`14,000/- per month, learned court has awarded
`10,000/- to both the applicants/revisionists as
maintenance. Annual income of husband was
assessed by the Income Tax Authority as `1,60,000/-
per annum. Therefore, I am not able to accept the
argument of Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned counsel for the
revisionists that, in fact, monthly income of husband
is `1,00,000/- per month. Maintenances, so awarded,
cannot be said to be on the lower side and
enhancement would be totally unjustified. Therefore,
revision fails and is hereby dismissed at the
admission stage.
